content:
maria: FYI planning a mid-tier slab refresh in us-east-3 this Sat 03:00-06:00 UTC. Staggered node reboots + NIC fw bump across 3 racks. Expected steady-state GPU capacity drop ~8% for ~2h.

alex: Only affects burst/spot-backed classes, right? Dedicated/private unaffected?

maria: Correct 100% Dedicated and Private VPCs not touched. We'll mark racks drainable before each reboot.

sam: For tenants pinned to us-east-3, do we have automatic failover?

maria: We'll flip routing policy to steer pinned traffic to eu-west1 and us-west2. Canary: 10% to eu-west1 for 20m then ramp.

jen: KV cache warmup is the usual pain. What's the plan for heavy seq models?

maria: Pre-seed hot prefixes 45m before each rack drain. Script example:

```
./kv-preseed --zone=us-east-3 --rack=rack-07 --prefixes-file=top500.txt --parallel=4
```

sre_lead: Add network hedging 1414 reduce BGP weight into eu-west1 during handoff so we don't saturate a single transit.

alex: Finance wants egress estimate. Any back-of-envelope numbers?

maria: Rough estimate: egress + spot backfill delta ~$5.8k for full window. I'll attach spreadsheet in runbook.

sam: What about long-running GPU jobs? Avoid mass evictions.

maria: Implement tenant-throttle policy: soft-throttle for non-critical long jobs, advertise shorter scheduling TTL to speed safe reschedule.

infra-bot: Action: create incident in #incidents and link runbook rb-2026-193. Suppress noisy alerts (gpu_temp, nvlink-flap).

jen: Need rollback plan for NIC fw if nvlink errors spike.

maria: Rollback: if nvlink-error-rate >0.25% sustained 10m -> revert NIC fw on cohort, failback traffic, page SRE lead. Escalation matrix in runbook.

sam: I'll own canary perf checks. Will run a smoke harness: 50 concurrent requests across gpt-l/long + embed-ml200, compare p50/p95 to baseline. I'll post results 30m after start.

alex: Product/comms note: enterprise tenants require 72h notice. Do both a targeted email and a public status update?

maria: Yes: targeted enterprise email (72h) + public status page (48h). Support on standby.

jen: I'll run NVLink health sweep tonight on candidate racks and share findings.

maria: Final checklist: preseed ready, BGP weight runbook validated, incident created, cost estimate added, enterprise comms queued. Any blockers?

alex: :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: maintenance/7260100000. Thread pinned.

maria: Thanks all. Closing planning unless new issues crop up.
